title: First-principles design of GaN–VHC (H = Cl, Br; C = Se, Te) van der Waals heterostructures for advanced optoelectronic applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13076-13085
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08190K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sheraz Ahmad, Shah Saleem Ullah, Haleem Ud Din, Irina Piyanzina, Cuong Q. Nguyen
In this study, we investigated the structural, optoelectronic, and photocatalytic properties of GaN-based van der Waals heterostructures incorporating halogens (Cl, Br) and chalcogens (Se, Te).
